video.subject_count.evidence: [director·claude] I counted every cell from 0.000 to 13.750. There is one white-haired knight on a skeletal horse and one treant the whole way through. From 8.000 to 9.000 the treant collapses; from 9.250 to 13.750 it is a single fallen log. One subject at the start and one body at the end, so the counts match. I saw no second treant, second knight or double, and nothing appears from nowhere.

video.no_text.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] The only text in any cell is the yellow timestamp in the top-left corner (for example 00:00:00.000). That is the contact sheet's own label, not part of the video. I found no subtitles, watermark, UI, health bar or skill name in any of the 56 cells. I could not run OCR, so this is a visual check only, on fairly small cells.

video.timeline.evidence: [director·claude] Several beats are wrong or missing. (1) Between 0.750 and 1.000 the framing suddenly pushes in close. From 4.000 to 5.750 the camera is behind the knight's back. From 6.000 to 7.750 it switches to a wide shot looking into the scene with the treant facing the camera. This breaks the spec's side view, 2.5 m camera height and smooth pan to the right. (2) In the 1.6–2.2 s frost beat, 2.000–2.250 show a bright blue glow where the sword hits the chest, not the shoulder. From 2.500 the treant turns pale white-blue all over, like a white frost shell or ice statue. That breaks 'dark blue cold fog, not white frost' and the negative terms 'sword glowing blue' and 'frozen into an ice statue'. (3) The 2.9–4.2 s escape to the right is barely visible. From 4.000 to 5.750 the treant stays close to the knight, crouching and twisting, with no clear run to the right. The two follow-up cuts at 4.2–5.1 s (back) and 5.1–6 s (shoulder) can't be made out. (4) From 6.000 to 7.750 the treant stands in place with its arms spread for almost 2 seconds. This hits the negative terms 'standing still' and 'treant frozen in place'. The 6–6.9 s parry-and-counter to the chest and the 6.9–7.8 s overhead cleave are not clearly visible. (5) The death happens at 8.000–9.250, slightly late, and at 9.000 the body briefly turns into a blue streak of smoke. (6) The 10.3–12 s beat where he reins in, turns the horse and walks back to look down: from 10.000 to 12.000 the horse stays facing right and barely moves, with no visible turn. Only 0–1 s (wind-up), 1–1.6 s (parry at 1.000–1.250), 7.8–10.3 s (falls and becomes a log) and 12–14 s (horse breath at 13.250) roughly happen.

video.scale.evidence: [director·claude] The size relationship is inconsistent. At 0.000–0.750 the treant is about level with the horse's head and its top reaches roughly the rider's waist, which matches the character card (1.9 m, standing to the rider's waist). From 1.000 to 3.750 the treant fills the right half of the frame and its crown is above the knight's head, clearly much bigger than the rider. From 4.000 to 5.750 the treant and the mounted knight are about the same height. From 6.000 to 7.750 its crown is again level with the rider's head. Changing camera distance partly explains this, but the treant is often taller than the mounted rider. It does not hold the 'up to the rider's waist' relationship.

video.head_tail.evidence: [director·claude] The opening is fine: from 0.000 to 0.750 the knight has his sword raised and the treant charges in, with no effects. The end mostly works: from 10.500 the log and the rider are visible, the blue fog has cleared, and from 12.000 to 13.000 the rider holds still. The problem is the last half second. The horse's white breath appears at 13.250 and is still visible fading at 13.500. Whether 13.500–14.000 is completely still is uncertain, and the half-second 'no new events' window is not clearly met. Also, a blue glow appears as early as 2.000, which doesn't match 'no glow effects'.

video.agency.evidence: [地狱领主·claude] 0–2.25 s works: at 0.0–0.75 s the sword is already raised and he faces the charging treant; at 1.0–1.75 s he swings; at 2.0–2.25 s the sword thrusts into the treant with a blue impact. Then he stops acting. At 2.5–3.25 s the blade hangs down and back toward the lower left, and he does not cut the treant's second arm. At 3.5–3.75 s the treant swings again and a blue burst appears near him, with no visible parry or counter from me. The 2.9–5.1 s spurring and back cut never happens: from 4.0 to 5.75 s I am seen from behind in roughly the same spot, the treant faces me and never flees, and the camera does not pan right. Of the 4.2–6.9 s strikes (back slash, shoulder chop, counter-cut to the chest), none can be confirmed as landing in the frames. At 7.0–7.5 s my horse barely moves, and in these 4 fps frames I cannot confirm the 6.9–7.8 s overhead chop. By 8.0 s the sword is already lowered at my side while the treant crumbles into blue fog by itself. At 9.0–9.75 s I do not rein in, turn the horse or ride back to the dead tree: I stay at the left side of the frame. Too much of my own action is missing or standing idle.；[树人·claude] In 0.0–0.75s I'm already standing right by the horse's head, and across those four frames I barely move or change pose. There's no 'full-speed charge' (spec 0–1s); it looks like I'm just standing there waiting. I only swing an arm at 1.0s. The spec has me turn and flee right at 2.9–4.2s, but in the 4.0–5.75s frames I'm still roughly facing the camera/left side with my arms flung out, and I can't see myself running right with my legs stepping the whole time. In 6.0–7.75s I'm standing almost in place with arms spread wide, posed the same in every frame. There's no 'turn back and swing an arm' at 6–6.9s, and no flinch or stagger when the sword hits me, so this is clearly standing frozen in place. In 8.0–8.75s I don't fall forward like a tree. I crouch and break up into blue particles, so I can't tell whether my reaction to being cut down is right. In short, both fleeing and fighting back are missing, and I stand there without acting.

video.gaze.evidence: [地狱领主·claude] 0–2.25 s: my head points right at the treant, which is correct. From 4.0 to 7.75 s the camera is behind me, and in some frames (around 4.25–4.5 s) my head is hidden by the cloak and hair, so I cannot confirm that I keep watching its back or shoulder. Not sure. At 12.0–13.75 s my face seems to turn toward the camera and the front of the frame instead of down at the dead tree lying beside the horse. At this resolution I cannot confirm that I keep looking at the corpse, so I judge this a fail.；[树人·claude] In 1.25–2.25s my face is front-on to the camera, looking straight out of the frame, not toward the rider on the left of frame (spec 1–1.6s: both should be locked on each other). In 2.5–3.75s the frost and my crown hide most of my face, so I can't confirm I'm looking at him or down at the frost on my body (spec 1.6–2.2s: look down at myself). In 4.25–4.5s my face is again front-on to the camera, with no 'looking back at him while running' or 'eyes on the road ahead'. In 6.0–7.75s my head points at the camera/background, with no turning back to stare at him and no 'looking up at the falling sword' (6.9–7.8s). In several frames I'm looking at the camera or my head direction can't be made out.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] 拼图里能看出：骑马的白发骑士（左）和树人（右）在打，1.0–1.75s 骑士挥剑、树人挥臂；2.0–2.25s 剑尖在树人胸口亮起一小团蓝光，2.5s 起树人全身变成冰白色；8.0–9.0s 树人化成蓝色粒子倒下，10.0–13.75s 只剩地上一截残木，骑士站在原地。所以“谁打中了谁、最后树人死了”大致能看懂，但我说不清骑士放的是什么技能。技能特效只是 2.0s 剑尖的一小团蓝光，看不出绚丽的施法过程。树人变白后在 3.5s 还挥臂反击，4.0–5.75s 还在走动、下蹲前扑，6.0–7.75s 张着手臂站着，我分不出它是被冻住、被晕住，还是只是变了颜色继续打。第 8 秒它为什么会碎掉，前面也没有新的命中镜头交代。另外，坐骑在 4.0–9.75s 从浅色骨马变成深色长毛的马，10s 后又变回浅色；树人头部也从绿叶变成深紫色的树冠，主体前后不一致，增加了理解难度。

video.fidelity.evidence: [fidelity·claude] 峰值图（第2张）锁定的霜寒长相是：树人深褐树皮还看得出，表面贴着一层压暗的深蓝寒雾和暗蓝薄霜，没有发光点。成片拼图（第1张）里技能最强的几格与此明显不符。①命中方式不对：第2行00:02.000和00:02.250两格，剑刃砍中处有一个亮蓝色发光光团，00:03.500和00:03.750两格砍臂时又有一团亮白偏蓝的爆闪，规格明确禁止发光特效和亮蓝色寒气。②颜色和样子不对：从00:02.500起，第2行到第4行（00:02.500至00:07.750），树人全身变成灰白、银白偏淡蓝，树皮原色基本看不见，像一尊白霜冰雕，对应负面词里的白色霜花和冻成冰雕，而不是峰值图那种深色树皮外面裹一层暗蓝半透明寒雾。③只有第5行00:08.000至00:09.750，劈倒后才冒出暗蓝寒雾，接近峰值图的颜色，可那已是技能主体结束之后。同一个技能前后两种长相，颜色和形状都走样，所以判不过。补充（只作说明，不影响本项结论）：第3张原版参考上标的是黄绿色光点、不是冰蓝色，还写着来源未确认（source unconfirmed）；蓝色霜效只出现在Dota 2的对照行里。所以‘蓝霜是不是6.83d原版样子’这一点我拿不准。

video.attack_contact.evidence: [director·claude] Only the first two hits clearly land. At 1.000–1.250 the sword meets the treant's arm. At 2.000–2.250 the blade overlaps the treant's chest and there is a hit glow, though the spec says shoulder. At 3.500–3.750 a blue burst near the knight overlaps the treant's arm; this may be the cut on the arm, but it is unclear. For the chain of cuts that follows, from 4.000 to 7.750, I can't see the blade cutting into the treant's back, shoulder or chest in any cell. From 6.000 to 7.750 the knight and the treant are visibly apart and the treant shows no stagger. At 6.750 the sword is raised toward the treant but doesn't reach it. During the collapse at 8.000–8.250 the knight's sword hangs at the horse's side, so I see no vertical cleave landing. The back slash, shoulder slash, chest counter and final cleave all lack visible contact, which hits the negative terms 'swinging at air' and 'sword doesn't reach the treant'.

video.stun_visible.evidence: [audience·claude] 树人头顶在任何一格都没有旋涡标记（2.5–7.75s 头顶只有深色树冠）。它被命中后也没有原地停住：3.5s 抬臂横扫骑士，4.0–4.75s 转身移动，5.0–5.5s 下蹲前扑，6.25s、6.75s、7.25s 手臂姿势一直在变，看起来是在继续行动，不是被定住。如果问“哪个单位被晕住了、晕了多久”，我只能看到树人被打中后变白然后还在动，答不出谁被晕、晕了几秒。唯一像定身的只有 6.0–7.75s 张开手臂站着那一段，但手臂和姿势仍在变化，也没有任何眩晕标识，所以我拿不准，判不过。
